    import pandas as pd

    df['FDR.phos'] = pd.to_numeric(df['FDR.phos'], errors='coerce')

    cbx3_mean = df.loc[df['Gene'].astype(str).str.strip().eq('CBX3'), 'FDR.phos'].mean()
    rest_mean = df.loc[~df['Gene'].astype(str).str.strip().eq('CBX3'), 'FDR.phos'].mean()

    diff = cbx3_mean - rest_mean

        'cbx3_mean_fdr': cbx3_mean,
        'rest_mean_fdr': rest_mean,
        'difference': diff
    }])
